items.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I didn’t meet Arlen, but I met Jule Styne and Burton Lane

ctx.x: Which one is easier to whistle?

“What Is This Thing Called Love,” exactly. That’s a good point because something that was commercially possible, people could whistle it, you know, the humblest guy. And it’s a very interesting point you say that, because one of the hardest songs probably written is “Blues In The Night.” There’s a middle strain on it, eight bar, it’s a kind of complicated [scats]. Harold Arlen and Johnny Mercer. That was probably one of their biggest hits simply because that catchy opening phrase: “My mommy done told me”…
Can you imagine, that would be a great feeling to be a songwriter, and hear people whistling your tune.
